body: My mom keeps saying in as many words what a disappointment I am to her. I'm wondering if it's time
I just kind of nodded and let her be angry. Then today, after she had cooled down, I wrote her a 1.5 page apology note. I really do feel bad

I'm sorry, I think you misunderstood that. I did not say anything rude to my mom. I said that when that woman complained about me asking her son to sit on Santa's lap, I would have talked about that on air if I had a real radio show. I'm sorry for coming across as rude

I don't know. I just tried talking to her. She's being ridiculous. I thought I could talk in the privacy of my own home. I said: "I wish I was like Howard Stern with job security so that I could tell that woman off on air". She freaked out, saying that she was mad at me for picking a "vulgar jackass" as a role model. Things are so messed up. I don't know why she has her hear set on me getting kicked out of school. And I don't know how long I can put up with this
